9794d105636f883c0fd1c6b17ed8a93b91077c27.source: 准备四种范式、逐项编辑问卷，设置作答提示与标准答案，使用键盘完成实验，查看被试反应时和准确率并保存结果。
9794d105636f883c0fd1c6b17ed8a93b91077c27.translation: Prepare four paradigms, edit questionnaires item by item, set response prompts and correct answers, run with a keyboard, inspect reaction times and accuracy, and save results.

c3f0cf4b2d0a4b303f134d10141f136d267d6305.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
c3f0cf4b2d0a4b303f134d10141f136d267d6305.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

a6a0e483f58014e4fb85bdb597745d34af981bd0.source: 感知实验可以在本机设计并运行辨认、相同/不同判断和参照匹配任务，记录问卷、反应键与反应时。打开工作台的<s id="0">标注与实验 → 感知实验</s>即可开始，无需登录，素材和结果不会自动上传。
a6a0e483f58014e4fb85bdb597745d34af981bd0.translation: Design and run identification, same/different, and reference-matching tasks locally, recording questionnaires, response keys, and reaction times. Open <s id="0">Annotation and experiments → Perception experiments</s>. No login is needed, and materials/results are not uploaded automatically.

20ac9a8141e6b05b133a59e857b12a534a23a354.source: 本章 ABX 流程使用六份 0.8 秒合成演示音和自动 J/F 按键。<s id="0">示例展示软件操作，正式研究数据需通过真人被试实验采集。</s>正式实验请使用检查过的材料，先完成一次预测试。
20ac9a8141e6b05b133a59e857b12a534a23a354.translation: This ABX example uses six 0.8-second synthesized demonstration sounds and automated J/F presses. <s id="0">The example demonstrates operation; collect formal research data from human participants.</s> Use checked materials and complete a pilot before the main experiment.

9e1547d1218cf066ee8e1cdc84b3297bb52353ca.translation: Main areas of the design page

9248ac9e53abfbbd387f5a2853053b544e847ac7.source: 选择范式，保存或加载设计。<s id="0">帮助</s>查看提示，<s id="1">方法与引用</s>查看来源。
9248ac9e53abfbbd387f5a2853053b544e847ac7.translation: Choose a paradigm and save/load designs. <s id="0">Help</s> opens instructions; <s id="1">Methods and references</s> shows sources.

76d2dd6bbdf9846a5a3e7a2f9f5505f4385b233e.source: 左栏选择<s id="0">素材、序列、参数、问卷、分析、资源与恢复</s>，对应内容在中央编辑；左栏还可按角色导入素材。
76d2dd6bbdf9846a5a3e7a2f9f5505f4385b233e.translation: Choose <s id="0">Materials, Sequence, Parameters, Questionnaire, Analysis, or Resources and recovery</s> on the left and edit in the center. Import materials by role on the left too.

b220312a6d496d24f55c9771fd268690c0426159.source: 进行<s id="0">预检与试音</s>，填写被试信息，查看<s id="1">本机记录</s>。
b220312a6d496d24f55c9771fd268690c0426159.translation: Run <s id="0">Preflight and sound check</s>, enter participant details, and view <s id="1">Local records</s>.

a709b1d05636289ccb1128085c00c0657caf5f8e.source: 退出运行后保留最近结果，可导出或点击<s id="0">查看结果</s>。
a709b1d05636289ccb1128085c00c0657caf5f8e.translation: After leaving the run, the latest results remain for export or <s id="0">View results</s>.

bc2436836343241e17b867fc593a2a7fe4209dc5.source: 导入一份示例 X 音频后的最大化素材页。顶部选择范式，左栏导入刺激与查看项目数量，中央查看素材清单，右栏进行预检并查看本机记录。
bc2436836343241e17b867fc593a2a7fe4209dc5.translation: Maximized Materials page after importing one example X audio. Paradigm selection is above, imports/counts left, material list center, and preflight/local records right.

a65edd06f6b157bd7459995cf0d9927af5e3853b.source: 感知实验素材页，显示一份 X 音频、范式选择、设计步骤和运行预检
a65edd06f6b157bd7459995cf0d9927af5e3853b.translation: Perception Materials page showing one X audio, paradigm selection, design steps, and run preflight.

fc1e627bb5b3fe5216b3893a77a2546859871691.source: 先设计，再开始一位被试
fc1e627bb5b3fe5216b3893a77a2546859871691.translation: Design first, then start one participant

5e389a75937f195dde5c44803028d55dce5bd3b9.source: 准备素材并选择范式 → 设置参数和反应键 → 核对序列与问卷 → 保存设计 → 预检、试音 → 填写被试信息 → 运行 → 保存和检查结果 → 为下一位重新准备。下面按这个顺序说明。
5e389a75937f195dde5c44803028d55dce5bd3b9.translation: Prepare materials and paradigm → parameters and response keys → sequence and questionnaire → save design → preflight and sound check → participant details → run → save/check results → prepare again for the next participant. The following follows this order.

b6e5fe7ede302edcbfd3508f3115bfb8d23e921b.translation: Choose a paradigm and import materials

db10d27fba53a8287aaae8b80002567d819b6625.source: <s id="0">X</s>：每试次一份 X，可用音频、图片或 UTF-8 TXT，适合单份材料的辨认或判断。
db10d27fba53a8287aaae8b80002567d819b6625.translation: <s id="0">X</s>: one X per trial, using audio, images, or UTF-8 TXT, for identification or judgment of a single item.

807ea5b667ccb13e05504069ee84a9c244f0552b.source: <s id="0">AX</s>：A → X 两份音频，可用来判断相同/不同。
807ea5b667ccb13e05504069ee84a9c244f0552b.translation: <s id="0">AX</s>: two audio items, A → X, for same/different judgments.

42c69cb3100d2afccb57c2a78152b7560648294e.source: <s id="0">ABX</s>：A → B → X 三份音频，可要求判断 X 更像 A 还是 B。
42c69cb3100d2afccb57c2a78152b7560648294e.translation: <s id="0">ABX</s>: three audio items, A → B → X, asking whether X is closer to A or B.

897f4dcb81aa640dbf35463ef574de9da61122fc.source: <s id="0">AXB</s>：A → X → B 三份音频，可要求判断中间的 X 更像哪一端。
897f4dcb81aa640dbf35463ef574de9da61122fc.translation: <s id="0">AXB</s>: three audio items, A → X → B, asking which endpoint the middle X resembles.

3b6b36fb58d911ca6c4119dd7c06a94a63df4952.source: 在顶部<s id="0">范式</s>下拉框选择，角色组和序列表随之变化。已有试次时会询问是否重建序列并清除按键分段与洗牌范围，素材和问卷保留。需要保留原设计时先导出项目，取消确认则维持原范式。
3b6b36fb58d911ca6c4119dd7c06a94a63df4952.translation: Select from the top <s id="0">Paradigm</s> list; role groups and sequence columns change. With existing trials, confirmation rebuilds the sequence and clears key segments/shuffle ranges while retaining materials/questionnaire. Export first to keep the design; canceling keeps the old paradigm.

33695eecebcda45c7525fda8a5a70e1fdbb66911.source: 在范式下拉框选择 ABX 后，素材页显示 A、B、X 三个角色组。此处尚未导入任何素材。
33695eecebcda45c7525fda8a5a70e1fdbb66911.translation: After selecting ABX, Materials shows A, B, and X groups, with nothing imported yet.

dce87a95b67eba8f1a0fb0e907391c69ab63120d.source: 在范式下拉框选择 ABX 后，素材页显示 A、B、X 三个角色组
dce87a95b67eba8f1a0fb0e907391c69ab63120d.translation: ABX selected; Materials shows A, B, and X groups.

8ef55fbb0f316ba6c026a9049e0a22a52ac2abd6.source: <s id="0">AX、ABX、AXB 只接受音频。</s>答案含义由指导语和反应键标签约定。
8ef55fbb0f316ba6c026a9049e0a22a52ac2abd6.translation: <s id="0">AX, ABX, and AXB accept audio only.</s> Define answer meanings through instructions and response-key labels.

78fbec7adf67180d80aa7aaac3c99bd5a1a1a0f4.source: 核对材料时长、起止静音、声道、采样率和音量，按 A/B/X 分组命名。应用不自动裁剪、归一化或校准响度。保留原文件与材料编码表，跨设备也要携带刺激本体。
78fbec7adf67180d80aa7aaac3c99bd5a1a1a0f4.translation: Check duration, leading/trailing silence, channels, sample rate, and level. Name files by A/B/X group. The app does not trim, normalize, or calibrate loudness automatically. Retain originals and coding tables; carry actual stimuli across devices.

ab276bde14b0f4d92e4acdcd9a4c921e5308abd1.source: 音频识别 WAV、MP3、OGG、M4A、FLAC、AAC、WMA、MP4 等扩展名，能否播放以预检解码为准。X 图片支持 JPG/JPEG、PNG、GIF、BMP、WebP 及可检查尺寸的静态 SVG；X 文本使用 UTF-8 TXT，按纯文本显示。
ab276bde14b0f4d92e4acdcd9a4c921e5308abd1.translation: Audio extensions include WAV, MP3, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, WMA, and MP4; preflight decoding determines playability. X images support JPG/JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP, and static SVG with inspectable dimensions. X text is UTF-8 TXT displayed as plain text.

726a9a878b5d7ef5e5de17ac17f3548794f04143.source: 最多 <s id="0">2000 份素材、10000 个试次</s>；运行至少需要 1 个试次。
726a9a878b5d7ef5e5de17ac17f3548794f04143.translation: At most <s id="0">2000 materials and 10000 trials</s>; a run requires at least 1 trial.

94b1f302631407bed0ee55317800efa24cfd60af.source: 单份非空文件最多 <s id="0">64 MiB</s>，全部原始素材最多 <s id="1">512 MiB</s>。TXT 最多 1 MiB。
94b1f302631407bed0ee55317800efa24cfd60af.translation: Each nonempty file: at most <s id="0">64 MiB</s>; all original materials: <s id="1">512 MiB</s>. TXT: at most 1 MiB.

d3059571c41e647f8dd7ff4ded7b5216856388f8.source: 图片最多 1600 万像素；SVG 最多 1 MiB，须有正数宽高且不含外部或活动内容。单刺激和单试次解码总量最多 128 MiB。
d3059571c41e647f8dd7ff4ded7b5216856388f8.translation: Images: at most 16 million pixels. SVG: 1 MiB, positive width/height, no external or active content. Decoded totals per stimulus and per trial: 128 MiB.

5642a278c2150a100f13a0afaacd34130e7de5cb.source: 拖入目录最多 16 层、4000 个扫描条目，最多取 2000 份支持素材；隐藏文件和不支持类型会跳过。
5642a278c2150a100f13a0afaacd34130e7de5cb.translation: Dropped directories: at most 16 levels, 4000 scanned entries, and 2000 supported materials. Hidden and unsupported files are skipped.

4d54336285d3f015d6c3b99b80512d9dbb1816bd.source: 导入文件最多 16 MiB；XLSX 首工作表最多 10000 数据行、31 列，ZIP 最多 2000 条目和 64 MiB 解压总量。MiB 按 1024×1024 字节计算。
4d54336285d3f015d6c3b99b80512d9dbb1816bd.translation: Import files: 16 MiB. First XLSX sheet: 10000 data rows and 31 columns. ZIP: 2000 entries and 64 MiB expanded total. MiB means 1024×1024 bytes.

4eacf523f6597e67a74b0a8abc560163bb5aabda.source: hash 是文件内容的校验标识。同名不同内容可能并存，结合<s id="0">预览</s>确认。
4eacf523f6597e67a74b0a8abc560163bb5aabda.translation: The hash identifies file contents. Same-name files with different content may coexist; use <s id="0">Preview</s> to confirm.

5c2948925378943ff625288d8d7824760086f101.source: 支持多选和拖入文件/目录，放入哪个角色框就属于哪个组；文件名不会自动分组。
5c2948925378943ff625288d8d7824760086f101.translation: Select multiple files or drop files/directories into a role box. The destination box determines the group; filenames do not group automatically.

25be257bc1261c9312563069efe713fb2f76e684.source: 音频显示播放器，图片直接显示，TXT 显示文字。预览会撤销原试音确认。
25be257bc1261c9312563069efe713fb2f76e684.translation: Audio shows a player, images show directly, and TXT shows text. Preview revokes earlier sound-check confirmation.

a0fa543bdf6b8d89f2b7cb3fd7ae3a74393ac634.source: 只调整当前项目清单，原文件和已保存会话保留。<s id="0">清空 X 组会同时清空试次表</s>。
a0fa543bdf6b8d89f2b7cb3fd7ae3a74393ac634.translation: Changes the current project list only; originals and saved sessions remain. <s id="0">Clearing X also clears trials</s>.

e4da3a8fb7dca14b7be4afaa165790f6324ea1eb.source: 先确认范式，在左栏对应刺激组点击<s id="0">选择或拖入素材</s>，选择一份或多份文件，也可直接拖到该组。ABX/AXB 分别导入 A、B、X，AX 导入 A、X。
e4da3a8fb7dca14b7be4afaa165790f6324ea1eb.translation: Confirm the paradigm, then <s id="0">Choose or drop materials</s> in each left-hand role group. Select one or more files or drop directly. Import A/B/X for ABX/AXB and A/X for AX.

05ecdeb783fb614697c4e38208b4b6930e7bbf1f.source: 等待读取反馈，检查中央清单及左栏数量。A/B/X 各两份可按位置生成两个试次。
05ecdeb783fb614697c4e38208b4b6930e7bbf1f.translation: Wait for loading feedback, then check central lists and left counts. Two files each in A/B/X can create two trials by position.

fb01568526830a8c7a369afdb6151603e1e05591.source: 同组、同路径且内容相同的重复选择会复用已有条目。提示类型、体积或数量错误时按消息处理，再以实际清单为准。
fb01568526830a8c7a369afdb6151603e1e05591.translation: Repeated selection of identical content at the same path in the same group reuses the entry. Address type, size, or count errors as reported, then check the actual list.

f9aa02798828c7073d86e04764fa1c17cf5a18a8.source: 六份合成演示音已分别导入 A、B、X 组，每份显示文件名、类型、内容 hash 和大小。三组均有两份素材，生成两个试次。
f9aa02798828c7073d86e04764fa1c17cf5a18a8.translation: Six synthesized sounds are imported into A, B, and X, showing filenames, types, hashes, and sizes. Each group has two items, creating two trials.

029d30e92ab394e0b48046d5c2c92d2ecacafa2e.source: 六份合成演示音已分别导入 A、B、X 组，每份显示文件名、类型、内容 hash 和大小
029d30e92ab394e0b48046d5c2c92d2ecacafa2e.translation: Six synthesized sounds imported into A, B, and X, each showing filename, type, hash, and size.

5941027d439202af22c4e563af08130cdd317113.source: 点击目标行<s id="0">预览</s>，核对文件内容。音频用控制条播放/暂停，检查完点击<s id="1">停止预览</s>。
5941027d439202af22c4e563af08130cdd317113.translation: Click <s id="0">Preview</s> on a row. Play/pause audio with its controls, then <s id="1">Stop preview</s> after checking.

a8025fde55cb2050f935bb4fa72b9411154200ea.source: 点击单项<s id="0">移除</s>，或点击<s id="1">清空 A/B/X 组</s>并确认。清空 X 后重新建立试次；移除单项或清空参照组后到序列页修复关联。
a8025fde55cb2050f935bb4fa72b9411154200ea.translation: <s id="0">Remove</s> an item, or <s id="1">Clear A/B/X group</s> and confirm. Rebuild trials after clearing X. After removal or clearing reference groups, repair links on Sequence.

905d3597c398a5c18ac205b7f5dd117fa08d0386.source: 正式运行前重新预检。<s id="0">预检会检查本次序列引用的全部刺激。</s>
905d3597c398a5c18ac205b7f5dd117fa08d0386.translation: Run preflight again before the formal run. <s id="0">It checks every stimulus referenced by this sequence.</s>

e2dc3305316bca3c76f369877e15ce2386b03d4c.source: 点击 A1-demo.wav 的预览后，素材清单下方显示实际音频播放器。预览会撤销旧试音确认，进入正式实验前需重新预检。此音频为合成演示刺激。
e2dc3305316bca3c76f369877e15ce2386b03d4c.translation: Previewing A1-demo.wav displays an actual player below the list and revokes old sound-check confirmation; rerun preflight before the experiment. This is a synthesized demonstration stimulus.

a0a63274d95191a5f821ec259eee95d356edeb38.source: 点击 A1-demo.wav 的预览后，素材清单下方显示实际音频播放器
a0a63274d95191a5f821ec259eee95d356edeb38.translation: Previewing A1-demo.wav shows an actual audio player below the material list.

843b54fa6f663f0ba1c5c963ea7480e4e6e8b244.source: 首次导入会以 X 数量按各组位置生成序列。试次经过手工调整后，新导入通常只补素材；明确重建时使用<s id="0">按分组生成序列</s>。
843b54fa6f663f0ba1c5c963ea7480e4e6e8b244.translation: The first import builds a sequence from X count and group positions. After manual trial edits, later imports usually add only materials. Use <s id="0">Generate sequence from groups</s> to rebuild explicitly.

5e786b9bb0f4482969e409c2190595dbdb4db6fa.source: 下表是<s id="0">新项目默认值</s>。载入项目会恢复其中已保存的设置。
5e786b9bb0f4482969e409c2190595dbdb4db6fa.translation: The table lists <s id="0">new-project defaults</s>. Loading a project restores its saved settings.

ac678c9b8b71604d0f4081427958e695e85e3670.source: 听觉感知实验；一段听音提示
ac678c9b8b71604d0f4081427958e695e85e3670.translation: Auditory perception experiment; a listening instruction

a281ef14af84de80fb3f624f84a09b2ce65b441e.source: 改成实际任务名称和说明，交代判断标准、按键、作答时点与休息办法。
a281ef14af84de80fb3f624f84a09b2ce65b441e.translation: Use the actual task name and explain criteria, keys, response timing, and breaks.

eb28b5bdf8e1dc35fb9973224d3119ee42ab433c.source: 试次间展示语、显示开关

1ec8d1d3736592aa0c1c8021f9a110d6701e15b4.source: 启用后在行指导语为空时显示全局文本。<s id="0">每行非空指导语优先，关闭全局开关也仍显示。</s>
1ec8d1d3736592aa0c1c8021f9a110d6701e15b4.translation: When enabled, global text appears if the row instruction is empty. <s id="0">Nonempty row instructions take priority and appear even with the global switch off.</s>

6a15469979ff5258f46d6950fb7142ac22ae3d6f.source: 指导语大字、阶段/试次间大字
6a15469979ff5258f46d6950fb7142ac22ae3d6f.translation: Large instructions / Large phase and between-trial text

e6eda0d2d8ece1cd9e11a5c4b9f52c58e517046f.source: 分别放大总指导语，以及阶段提示和试次间文字。
e6eda0d2d8ece1cd9e11a5c4b9f52c58e517046f.translation: Enlarges overall instructions and phase/between-trial text separately.

684b799a708552b8d57c831580d41dd006bc66f0.source: 同一试次中相邻音频角色的静默间隔，X 没有角色间隔。允许 0–3600000 ms。
684b799a708552b8d57c831580d41dd006bc66f0.translation: Silence between adjacent audio roles in one trial. X has no inter-role gap. Range 0–3600000 ms.

16e25ddc2864d5ee81e4c6b4b2c9d1414394e205.source: 自动推进在试次间页等待的时间，第一个试次也使用。准备素材和提示音另占时间，允许 0–3600000 ms。
16e25ddc2864d5ee81e4c6b4b2c9d1414394e205.translation: Waiting time on the between-trial page during automatic progression, also before the first trial. Material preparation and cue sound add time. Range 0–3600000 ms.

ee58592d7709f6cddd9c4d1f73fcc774801396fd.source: <s id="0">按键继续</s>按空格或回车进入试次，也可点击按钮。
ee58592d7709f6cddd9c4d1f73fcc774801396fd.translation: With <s id="0">Press to continue</s>, press Space or Enter, or click the button, to enter a trial.

e50c9017de41bda37b7ef228f0589fe7a8df2ad5.source: 关闭后，进入试次还要按空格、回车或点击<s id="0">播放当前试次</s>或按空格、回车。
e50c9017de41bda37b7ef228f0589fe7a8df2ad5.translation: When off, after entering a trial, press Space or Enter or click <s id="0">Play current trial</s> to start playback.

56291c852995954023454d03968750230e305707.source: 提示音在刺激前播放；文件名只显示 X 名称，可能透露实验条件。
56291c852995954023454d03968750230e305707.translation: The cue precedes stimuli. Filename display shows X only and may reveal experimental conditions.

d1123fbee9c13f1416999aa12323af0ddc96eb03.source: 参数页展示实验标题、指导语、ISI、试次间隔、推进方式、播放与显示开关，以及全局反应键。画面中的一份素材和示例文字仅用于说明设置位置。
d1123fbee9c13f1416999aa12323af0ddc96eb03.translation: Parameters page showing title, instructions, ISI, inter-trial interval, progression, playback/display switches, and global keys. The one material and example text only identify setting locations.

6e4f47d04c3c6a5c9892918e2389b6ef74d92797.source: 感知实验参数页，展示标题、指导语、ISI、试次间隔、推进方式、多个开关和全局按键
6e4f47d04c3c6a5c9892918e2389b6ef74d92797.translation: Perception Parameters page showing title, instructions, ISI, inter-trial interval, progression, switches, and global keys.

5778e657a05ef4b8c06d099ce6a182c53a5dd41f.source: 指导语、阶段提示和试次间文字支持 <s id="0"><br></s> 换行及 <s id="1"><strong></s> 加粗，也支持斜体、下划线等静态格式；脚本、样式和外链资源会被清理。填好后预测试检查实际显示。
5778e657a05ef4b8c06d099ce6a182c53a5dd41f.translation: Instructions, phase prompts, and between-trial text support <s id="0"><br></s> breaks and <s id="1"><strong></s> bold, plus static italic/underline formatting. Scripts, styles, and external resources are removed. Pilot the actual display after editing.

68ccaf5dac800a024795403ddf1ce696c6fc10db.source: 在<s id="0">参数</s>页修改标题和指导语，分别填写 ISI 与试次间隔。ISI 控制角色之间的间隔，两项不要混淆。
68ccaf5dac800a024795403ddf1ce696c6fc10db.translation: Edit title/instructions on <s id="0">Parameters</s> and set ISI and inter-trial interval separately. ISI is between roles; do not confuse them.

20ea55065cf926b237eee6dc292f996cdbc1ecf8.source: 需要让被试自行阅读文字时，把<s id="0">推进方式</s>设为<s id="1">按键继续</s>。若同时关闭<s id="2">自动播放</s>，需先进入试次，再启动播放。
20ea55065cf926b237eee6dc292f996cdbc1ecf8.translation: For self-paced reading, set <s id="0">Progression</s> to <s id="1">Press to continue</s>. If <s id="2">Autoplay</s> is also off, enter the trial first, then start playback.

c2cdf94e190873063519d2c2d05a20fbbbc727fa.source: 按研究需要设置提示音、文件名和大字。改动设计会撤销预检和试音确认，运行前重新检查。
c2cdf94e190873063519d2c2d05a20fbbbc727fa.translation: Set cue sound, filename display, and large text as needed. Design changes revoke preflight and sound-check confirmation; check again before running.

ceaa736884e198901e897d31ed01e392d815c23e.source: 此演示将推进方式设为按键继续，关闭自动播放与提示音，ISI 设为 300 ms，并编辑 J/F 的含义。这些演示设置不同于新项目默认值。
ceaa736884e198901e897d31ed01e392d815c23e.translation: This demonstration uses Press to continue, autoplay and cue off, ISI 300 ms, and edited J/F meanings. These differ from new-project defaults.

3cc77643882ab8d572409e4a2aeccb10cdb8c63e.source: 此演示将推进方式设为按键继续，关闭自动播放与提示音，ISI 设为 300 ms，并编辑 J/F 的含义
3cc77643882ab8d572409e4a2aeccb10cdb8c63e.translation: Demonstration settings: Press to continue, autoplay/cue off, ISI 300 ms, and edited J/F meanings.

e7788cc390203c2c91c4478bd7ae9cdd8148a084.source: 作答页提示语可在参数页编辑，并用显示作答页提示语开关决定是否显示。开启后，在刺激播放和等待作答的同一页面呈现提示，例如判断 X 更接近 A 还是 B。默认关闭，载入旧项目也保持关闭。该提示与试次间展示语分别控制。
e7788cc390203c2c91c4478bd7ae9cdd8148a084.translation: Edit response-page prompts in Parameters and toggle Show response-page prompt. When on, the prompt appears during playback and response waiting, for example asking whether X is closer to A or B. Default is off, including older loaded projects. It is controlled separately from between-trial text.

9a87291359ac38762a8f9888fc5bcf25a8eca0ce.source: 全局键、分段键与阶段提示
9a87291359ac38762a8f9888fc5bcf25a8eca0ce.translation: Global keys, segmented keys, and phase prompts

2ab541572b808ffe97da98fb06e44b23dffd3c23.source: 先把默认 F/J 的错误/正确示例标签改成实际含义，并与指导语一致。<s id="0">需要计算准确率时，在序列页为各试次设置标准答案，选择该试次实际使用的反应键。未设置的试次不计分。</s>
2ab541572b808ffe97da98fb06e44b23dffd3c23.translation: Replace default F/J Incorrect/Correct example labels with actual meanings matching instructions. <s id="0">For accuracy, set a correct answer for each trial on Sequence using a response key active in that trial. Trials without one are unscored.</s>

3d9a77d1c0efa7a1d387573f97d3a3e3b8b26050.source: 全局按键、添加按键、移除

f82cae9fe7edaaf8778f57d5c0dd9de8a6e5238f.source: 英文字母、数字或空格，大小写等价，每个列表内不重复。新键初始为空，要填好；全局至少保留一个合法键。
f82cae9fe7edaaf8778f57d5c0dd9de8a6e5238f.translation: English letters, digits, or space; case-insensitive and unique within each list. New keys start empty; fill them. Keep at least one valid global key.

e199034ed530efbbc6e9c8dad901f72d0ad384d4.source: 添加按键分段、起始/末尾试次
e199034ed530efbbc6e9c8dad901f72d0ad384d4.translation: Add key segment / Starting and ending trial

67b315b5bfcb8678a65c9c4481cc81ae8ebd83fe.source: 初始范围为 1 到当前末尾，包含首尾；重叠时采用列表中<s id="0">第一个匹配段</s>。
67b315b5bfcb8678a65c9c4481cc81ae8ebd83fe.translation: Initially 1 through the current last trial, inclusive. Overlaps use the <s id="0">first matching segment</s> in list order.

ded23fe7647625e1cfc3b65a14750ffc4d383058.source: 在生效段的起始试次前显示，阅读后点击<s id="0">继续阶段</s>或按空格、回车。
ded23fe7647625e1cfc3b65a14750ffc4d383058.translation: Appears before the active segment's starting trial. Read it, then <s id="0">Continue phase</s> or press Space/Enter.

c2ccaec358dfa655cae469bd4f64283f4d727f35.source: 分段没有非空键时沿用全局。填写分段键后使用该段的完整键列表，空项须补齐或移除。
c2ccaec358dfa655cae469bd4f64283f4d727f35.translation: Without nonempty segment keys, global keys apply. Once provided, the segment's entire key list is used; fill or remove empty entries.

abff8f11d20dfa9b3be4cf549c6722dbae1ce09b.source: 移除该范围与提示，相关位置使用其他生效段或全局键。
abff8f11d20dfa9b3be4cf549c6722dbae1ce09b.translation: Removes its range and prompt. Affected trials use another matching segment or global keys.

2b2d6540046077ac073e14ceb53a7c85adbf1d53.source: 需要不同阶段提示或按键时，点击<s id="0">添加按键分段</s>，填写试次位置、阶段提示与所需键；沿用全局键可不添加分段键。
2b2d6540046077ac073e14ceb53a7c85adbf1d53.translation: For distinct phase prompts or keys, <s id="0">Add key segment</s> and enter trial range, prompt, and keys. Leave segment keys absent to use global keys.

6ca4564ed6b7c4b152344e58e8035916fdaea05a.source: 改序、复制或移除试次后重新核对范围。分段只控制提示和按键，练习反馈与练习结果的区分需另行设计。
6ca4564ed6b7c4b152344e58e8035916fdaea05a.translation: Recheck ranges after moving, copying, or deleting trials. Segments control only prompts and keys; design practice feedback and practice-result separation separately.

7fcd0dac296c1b0fddb6c0645e103001c3bed4bd.source: 预测试用真实键盘检查按键。作答时焦点放在呈现区，每次按键后松开；长按、组合键、输入法组合及未松开的同一键不会成为新答案。Tab 与按钮等控件的正常键盘操作仍保留。
7fcd0dac296c1b0fddb6c0645e103001c3bed4bd.translation: Pilot with a real keyboard. Keep focus in the presentation area and release after each press. Holds, shortcuts, input-method composition, and the same unreleased key do not become new answers. Normal Tab/button navigation remains available.

0bda963f9f4df32643ac101972cf4dbdbf9f8e59.source: 按键分段设为第 1 至 2 试次，包含阶段提示和 J/F 两个分段键。分段范围包含首尾，进入起始试次前显示阶段提示。此配置为操作演示。
0bda963f9f4df32643ac101972cf4dbdbf9f8e59.translation: Key segment spans trials 1 through 2, with a phase prompt and J/F keys. Endpoints are included, and the prompt appears before the first trial. This is an operation example.

a4aee9cd688d74fe06e9850ebf7a97131804db5e.source: 按键分段设为第 1 至 2 试次，包含阶段提示和 J/F 两个分段键
a4aee9cd688d74fe06e9850ebf7a97131804db5e.translation: Key segment for trials 1 through 2 with a phase prompt and J/F keys.

e669578a689a2080112508b20299a640c5506824.source: 每份 X 生成一行，A/B 按各组同一位置配对。<s id="0">会覆盖手工试次表</s>，不生成所有组合，多余参照不增加试次。
e669578a689a2080112508b20299a640c5506824.translation: Creates one row per X, pairing A/B by position. <s id="0">Overwrites the manual trial table</s>. It does not generate all combinations; extra references do not add trials.

40f60606cc6c87cff0c6feae52c357033ff88678.source: 下拉选项显示名称、hash 和组标记；手动允许明确跨组选择，须核对内容与设计。
40f60606cc6c87cff0c6feae52c357033ff88678.translation: Options show name, hash, and group. Manual cross-group selection is allowed explicitly; check content and design.

6a010ff0bbd838c5718d009c2ad89cd0b0ada31c.source: 属于整行，显示在该试次间隔页，优先于全局文字；不在每个角色播放前重复显示。
6a010ff0bbd838c5718d009c2ad89cd0b0ada31c.translation: Belongs to the entire row and appears on its between-trial page, overriding global text. It is not repeated before every role.

c3ba3c62c0919a7f9408887ee72a50b1274a933a.source: 按 X 文件名移动整行。数字命名的实际顺序需核对，必要时补齐编号。
c3ba3c62c0919a7f9408887ee72a50b1274a933a.translation: Moves whole rows by X filename. Check actual numeric-filename order and pad numbers if needed.

2068bb2f4c20f91db9fd58f6654f9ea9d7243f01.source: 整行改位置；复制在下方加入独立试次并保留配对/指导语，移除试次不移除素材。
2068bb2f4c20f91db9fd58f6654f9ea9d7243f01.translation: Moves the whole row. Duplicate adds an independent trial below, preserving pairing/instruction. Trial removal does not remove materials.

038cc6fa2a29c1a9fad05f103fa52ec7f4577c56.source: 检查每一行的素材关联

c2674ed6da73dee4d1961bb00f3103cceaf21995.source: 打开<s id="0">序列</s>。需要重建时点击<s id="1">按分组生成序列</s>；例如 X 有两份、B 只有一份，第二行 B 会缺失。
c2674ed6da73dee4d1961bb00f3103cceaf21995.translation: Open <s id="0">Sequence</s>; rebuild with <s id="1">Generate sequence from groups</s> if needed. With two X files but one B, row two lacks B.

4a9d7804b7bdf0da45f0bd7c13cff76e9d75021c.source: 逐行核对每个角色的文件名、hash 和组标记。出现<s id="0">缺失 / 未关联</s>时，用下拉框明确选择，或补入正确文件。
4a9d7804b7bdf0da45f0bd7c13cff76e9d75021c.translation: Check names, hashes, and group marks for every role on every row. For <s id="0">Missing / Unlinked</s>, choose explicitly or import the correct file.

212d7e65e9011b1b83e89dbb73c4a9462177c970.source: 同一参照可以在多行重复选择，重复试次可用<s id="0">复制</s>或 XLSX 重复行。补齐后核对同名文件的内容，再重新预检。
212d7e65e9011b1b83e89dbb73c4a9462177c970.translation: The same reference may appear in multiple rows. Use <s id="0">Duplicate</s> or repeated XLSX rows for extra trials. Check same-name contents after repairs, then rerun preflight.

3c8ce2ffbf23d95a7feb581cd67ac7f18898c2b1.source: A、X 各两份而 B 只有一份时，第二试次缺少 B。预检会阻止进入被试流程；补齐素材并核对关联后再预检。素材均为合成演示音。
3c8ce2ffbf23d95a7feb581cd67ac7f18898c2b1.translation: With two A and X files but one B, trial two lacks B. Preflight blocks participant entry until materials and links are repaired. All sounds are synthesized demonstrations.

8a3340967bd6a3679df544838e7dfe1f8f5cf441.source: A、X 各两份而 B 只有一份时，第二试次缺少 B
8a3340967bd6a3679df544838e7dfe1f8f5cf441.translation: Two A and X files but one B leave trial two without B.

b4a8cf7f8a66fa28758706544260cafa4d90ee79.source: 表格放不下时用底部<s id="0">横向滚动条</s>，或<s id="1">收起右侧运行与记录栏</s>扩大中央区域，查看右端的<s id="2">试次指导语</s>与行操作。A/B 列仍在左侧。
b4a8cf7f8a66fa28758706544260cafa4d90ee79.translation: Use the bottom <s id="0">horizontal scrollbar</s> or <s id="1">collapse the run and records panel</s> to widen the editor and inspect rightmost <s id="2">Trial instruction</s> and row tools. A/B remain left.

3ee416a9370ec5908a4a7eb3411e68f6b745e35d.source: 填写每行指导语，使用<s id="0">↑、↓、拖动行</s>微调位置，或用<s id="1">正序 A–Z / 倒序 Z–A</s>整体排序。首行上移、末行下移不可用。
3ee416a9370ec5908a4a7eb3411e68f6b745e35d.translation: Fill row instructions, move with <s id="0">↑, ↓, or drag</s>, or sort all with <s id="1">Ascending A–Z / Descending Z–A</s>. Moving the first up or last down is disabled.

51f420fb0de57198f3bd0af8e51165455e8c7754.source: 修改完检查配对、指导语、总试次数，以及按位置定义的按键段和洗牌范围，再保存最终设计。
51f420fb0de57198f3bd0af8e51165455e8c7754.translation: After edits, check pairings, instructions, total trials, and position-defined key segments/shuffle ranges, then save the final design.

b8865f16e9797f2c5f12a4fad4464d82987cb4e9.source: 收起右侧运行与记录栏并将序列表横向滚到右端后，可见 X 关联、各行试次指导语以及上移、下移、移除和复制按钮。A/B 关联仍在同一行左侧，检查时向左滚动查看。项目使用合成演示刺激。
b8865f16e9797f2c5f12a4fad4464d82987cb4e9.translation: After collapsing the run/records panel and scrolling Sequence right, X links, row instructions, and up/down/remove/duplicate controls are visible. A/B links remain left in each row. Scroll left to check them. Stimuli are synthesized demonstrations.

fbabc5ccd6b0616adc6a3448a4018fb8491bc41f.source: 收起右侧运行与记录栏并将序列表横向滚到右端后，可见 X 关联、各行试次指导语以及上移、下移、移除和复制按钮
fbabc5ccd6b0616adc6a3448a4018fb8491bc41f.translation: Collapsed run/records panel and right-scrolled Sequence showing X links, instructions, and up/down/remove/duplicate controls.

7c6f4caa1ad437ad488e0a3de29e1c803d36df99.source: 忽略已设范围，对完整试次表洗牌，整行关联和指导语一起移动。
7c6f4caa1ad437ad488e0a3de29e1c803d36df99.translation: Ignores ranges and shuffles the whole table, moving links and instructions together.

afdbbcbfc8864d3877416a0622483baf6878f32d.source: 添加洗牌范围、按范围洗牌

50449674d1e108a3bcc499522c2adfa49be4ac62.source: 起始/末尾从 1 计数，包含首尾。范围外不动，重叠按列表顺序执行；<s id="0">没有范围时作用于全表</s>。
50449674d1e108a3bcc499522c2adfa49be4ac62.translation: Start/end are 1-based and inclusive. Outside rows stay unchanged; overlaps run in list order. <s id="0">Without ranges, the whole table is affected</s>.

06fcb4926c4ccb1712da3f692aa21a5339246e4d.source: 移除配置范围，不还原已经改变的顺序。
06fcb4926c4ccb1712da3f692aa21a5339246e4d.translation: Removes the range setting without restoring already shuffled order.

fc6d70b74fc5a4e852be0bb99b14bd5694607ef0.source: 先保存洗牌前的配对和顺序。填入种子，需要局部洗牌时添加合法范围，再点击对应洗牌按钮。
fc6d70b74fc5a4e852be0bb99b14bd5694607ef0.translation: Save pairings and order before shuffling. Enter the seed, add valid ranges for partial shuffling, then click the appropriate shuffle button.

94e5c21e8255b25e82a8da1a8548f055d668539f.source: 检查最终行顺序和分段，保存项目并导出序列。<s id="0">相同种子还需要相同起始顺序和范围才能复现</s>，连续点击不会恢复原顺序。
94e5c21e8255b25e82a8da1a8548f055d668539f.translation: Check final order and segments, save the project, and export the sequence. <s id="0">The same seed also needs the same starting order and ranges for reproduction</s>. Repeated clicks do not restore the original.

135458c3c14a57be6ac0e1dd86f6653a7156b8e2.source: 会话使用建立时的最终顺序，<s id="0">每位被试不会自动重新洗牌</s>。需要不同顺序时，在下一会话建立前明确修改并保存。
135458c3c14a57be6ac0e1dd86f6653a7156b8e2.translation: Sessions use the final order at creation; <s id="0">each participant is not reshuffled automatically</s>. Set and save another order explicitly before creating the next session.

a89370c0176558e26c95b9f4f42503b6a5fa5d77.source: 序列页展示随机种子与第 1 至 2 试次闭区间，图中尚未点击洗牌。横向滚动可查看指导语与行操作。实验条件的平衡需按研究设计另行安排。
a89370c0176558e26c95b9f4f42503b6a5fa5d77.translation: Sequence shows the seed and inclusive trial range 1 through 2, before shuffling. Scroll horizontally for instructions/tools. Arrange experimental-condition balance separately in the research design.

8bc8097e8c5f48a57d103c7d071d6616ff00efbb.source: 序列页展示随机种子与第 1 至 2 试次闭区间，图中尚未点击洗牌
8bc8097e8c5f48a57d103c7d071d6616ff00efbb.translation: Sequence showing the seed and inclusive range 1 through 2 before shuffling.

d6c1f43b1c0a4d82bda479bfdc6b8bfaa63ef7da.source: 新项目有必填的姓名/编号文本题与性别单选题。按需要改名，选择文本、单选、多选，移除不需收集的内容。
d6c1f43b1c0a4d82bda479bfdc6b8bfaa63ef7da.translation: New projects contain required Name/ID text and Gender single-choice questions. Rename as needed, choose text/single/multiple choice, and remove unneeded data collection.

5b09606654598116cffde15d1c3807dbb2f73ce4.source: 选项、添加选项、移除选项

b5e26157f43e6d7375791138d753d2db212b2097.source: 单选、多选的每个选项独立一行。点击添加选项后填写文字，可在文字中正常输入中英文逗号。移除不需要的选项，不留空白或重复项。
b5e26157f43e6d7375791138d753d2db212b2097.translation: Each single/multiple-choice option has its own row. Add and fill options; Chinese/English commas may appear in the text. Remove unneeded options and avoid blank or duplicate entries.

699adc78425a3a3ec94516cfa82980b4faa312de.source: 文本须有非空内容，单选须选一项，多选须至少选一项。
699adc78425a3a3ec94516cfa82980b4faa312de.translation: Text must be nonempty, single choice needs one selection, and multiple choice at least one.

cde733cb1b3574f892febba392e2bdf5c7a9edc8.source: 添加问卷题目、移除题目

2c60177d2bba4dcc0250ad9e2f9a659a12a963fb.source: 新题初始为必填文本题，先改题名再选类型。移除只改变当前设计，已有会话问卷保留。
2c60177d2bba4dcc0250ad9e2f9a659a12a963fb.translation: New questions start as required text. Rename before choosing a type. Removal changes only current design; existing session answers remain.

1e76b8d7d9e596389b6ba0c366670c14fa16b8d5.source: 在<s id="0">问卷</s>页编辑并保存，预检会检查题名与选项。进入被试表单后再核对题型、星号和选项。题名会进入 <s id="1">Q_</s> 开头的结果列，避免清理空白和标点后产生同名列。
1e76b8d7d9e596389b6ba0c366670c14fa16b8d5.translation: Edit and save on <s id="0">Questionnaire</s>. Preflight checks titles/options. Check types, asterisks, and options again on the participant form. Titles become result columns beginning <s id="1">Q_</s>; avoid duplicates after whitespace/punctuation cleanup.

106d727aabe093bdb4ece8d240847bdc41c1e57b.source: 问卷设计同时展示文本、单选和多选三种题型，以及必填设置和可逐项编辑、增删的选项。可按研究需要调整题目与选项。
106d727aabe093bdb4ece8d240847bdc41c1e57b.translation: Questionnaire design showing text, single-choice and multiple-choice questions, required settings, and options that can be edited, added or removed individually. Adjust questions and options to the study.

f11e928c6be85c018e863a624906f54a61910079.source: 问卷设计同时展示文本、单选和多选三种题型，以及必填设置和可逐项编辑、增删的选项
f11e928c6be85c018e863a624906f54a61910079.translation: Questionnaire design showing text, single-choice and multiple-choice questions, required settings, and options that can be edited, added or removed individually.

24c56bb545266b1b6619104c61ec5b267e14ff89.source: 每次会话有独立的被试和会话 ID。表格 <s id="0">Participant_ID</s> 优先取题名含姓名/编号的第一道文本答案，否则取第一道文本答案，没有文本题则为 Anonymous。多选在表格中以分号连接，JSON 保留数组。
24c56bb545266b1b6619104c61ec5b267e14ff89.translation: Each session has independent participant/session IDs. <s id="0">Participant_ID</s> uses the first text answer whose title contains 姓名/编号, otherwise the first text answer, or Anonymous without text questions. Tables join multiple selections with semicolons; JSON retains arrays.

c9984d11193ba24b68f3fd8ee3d7c7b088a51584.source: 资源助手与试次工作簿

e104b1ad498bb7005064e87a89ab2b7926a3a788.source: 资源与恢复中的表格控件
e104b1ad498bb7005064e87a89ab2b7926a3a788.translation: Spreadsheet controls in Resources and recovery

4ecc8ea62016c62a3ae5d8f0a25ec11e7708ad81.source: 只加在表格路径文本前，不读取该磁盘位置。
4ecc8ea62016c62a3ae5d8f0a25ec11e7708ad81.translation: Prepended only to path text in the workbook; the disk location is not read.

bfaf734d770035ce908a6a74413d1490f7d77328.source: 目录生成 XLSX 模板

0d44cf14cae2d3f8b9e7443a031c60d0cba5c6a3.source: 生成 <s id="0">m15-resources.xlsx</s>，文件路径先进入范式的首角色列，其他角色/指导语需编辑。
0d44cf14cae2d3f8b9e7443a031c60d0cba5c6a3.translation: Creates <s id="0">m15-resources.xlsx</s>, initially placing paths in the paradigm's first-role column. Edit other roles and instructions.

f3a2e110db7a92d83f3d769aafa7f44be208bfd7.source: 生成 <s id="0">m15-sequence.xlsx</s>，含当前角色路径、行指导语和各角色 SHA-256。
f3a2e110db7a92d83f3d769aafa7f44be208bfd7.translation: Creates <s id="0">m15-sequence.xlsx</s> with current role paths, row instructions, and role SHA-256 values.

480cded5d2140b249afc7343c036a64d4a493af0.source: 只读第一工作表，<s id="0">替换当前试次表</s>，不导入刺激本体。
480cded5d2140b249afc7343c036a64d4a493af0.translation: Reads only the first worksheet and <s id="0">replaces current trials</s>, without importing stimulus files.

363efa8995d08ae57e1fb22719a85a9527d9e4c0.source: 请求浏览器尽量保留记录，是否批准由浏览器决定，仍需外部文件备份。
363efa8995d08ae57e1fb22719a85a9527d9e4c0.translation: Asks the browser to retain records where possible. Approval is browser-controlled; external backups are still needed.

240cd4ce7d949d1a004e923222223311dcde0bab.translation: Generate a template from a directory

cd392ae5bc846ca24f9fc00179170a72cd1e2bba.source: 进入<s id="0">资源与恢复</s>，需要时填写<s id="1">路径前缀</s>。点击<s id="2">目录生成 XLSX 模板</s>选择目录，或把目录拖入此页。
cd392ae5bc846ca24f9fc00179170a72cd1e2bba.translation: Open <s id="0">Resources and recovery</s>, enter a <s id="1">Path prefix</s> if needed, then <s id="2">Generate XLSX template from directory</s> or drop a directory here.

5ce0c139bde90eb44055987d8d30b92c36dbb8af.source: 保存并打开模板。每份目录文件占一行，复杂范式不会按文件夹名自动配对 A/B/X，需在表格中整理成实际试次。
5ce0c139bde90eb44055987d8d30b92c36dbb8af.translation: Save and open the template. Each directory file occupies a row. Complex paradigms do not pair A/B/X by folder name; arrange actual trials in the spreadsheet.

c0b80172c303748977eb2db73a269fe0275b643a.source: 原文件仍须在应用中导入对应组；路径文本不能直接播放。已有序列时，导出当前序列通常更方便继续编辑。
c0b80172c303748977eb2db73a269fe0275b643a.translation: Import original files into role groups too; path text cannot play directly. With an existing sequence, exporting it is usually easier for further editing.

cbce944148711257af0e889096096ed636ce0b8a.source: 资源与恢复页提供路径前缀、目录生成 XLSX 模板和当前序列导入/导出。已用合成演示目录实际生成模板，反馈要求检查保存文件。模板提供路径文本，不自动配对三个角色。
cbce944148711257af0e889096096ed636ce0b8a.translation: Resources and recovery provides prefix, directory-to-XLSX template, and sequence import/export. A template was generated from the synthesized-demo directory, with a notice to check the saved file. Paths do not pair roles automatically.

ef74e21f747d5318c3316b841435402283853af8.source: 资源与恢复页提供路径前缀、目录生成 XLSX 模板和当前序列导入/导出
ef74e21f747d5318c3316b841435402283853af8.translation: Resources and recovery showing path prefix, directory-to-XLSX template, and current sequence import/export.

e29008eb1f1f8bd63d9069a764c18fd5ae175d53.source: 在表格中明确每个试次
e29008eb1f1f8bd63d9069a764c18fd5ae175d53.translation: Define each trial in the workbook

2613dab50a00b8affc48584c4b489624b8bcbf01.source: 每行一个试次，X 用 <s id="0">File_Path</s> 或 <s id="1">File_X</s>，复杂范式按角色填 <s id="2">File_A</s>、<s id="3">File_B</s>、<s id="4">File_X</s>。在 <s id="5">Inter_Trial_Instruction</s> 填行指导语，按需保留 <s id="6">SHA256_A、SHA256_B、SHA256_X</s>。例如：
2613dab50a00b8affc48584c4b489624b8bcbf01.translation: Use one trial per row. X uses <s id="0">File_Path</s> or <s id="1">File_X</s>. Complex paradigms use <s id="2">File_A</s>, <s id="3">File_B</s>, and <s id="4">File_X</s>. Put row instructions in <s id="5">Inter_Trial_Instruction</s> and retain <s id="6">SHA256_A、SHA256_B、SHA256_X</s> as needed. For example:

df05fee40f0bfb68bd8d227547ecb7b434f4d7c4.source: 这是文件名书写示例，需要准备实际文件。重复文件名可共用参照，重复整行可安排额外试次。AXB 仍按 A → X → B 播放，列位置不改变呈现顺序。
df05fee40f0bfb68bd8d227547ecb7b434f4d7c4.translation: These are filename examples; prepare actual files. Repeated filenames can reuse references, and repeated rows add trials. AXB still plays A → X → B; column order does not change presentation order.

02063deef38184df4a6d47cf3398d11fbf08995d.source: 表头不区分大小写，兼容 <s id="0">File_A/A</s>、<s id="1">File_B/B</s>、<s id="2">File_X/X</s> 和 X 的 <s id="3">File_Path/Path</s>；指导语列兼容 Instruction 或含展示语的列名。无表头时按当前范式角色顺序读列，下一列为指导语。空行跳过。建议保留表头，把试次表放到首工作表，另存 XLSX。
02063deef38184df4a6d47cf3398d11fbf08995d.translation: Headers are case-insensitive, accepting <s id="0">File_A/A</s>, <s id="1">File_B/B</s>, <s id="2">File_X/X</s>, and X's <s id="3">File_Path/Path</s>. Instruction also accepts Instruction or names containing 展示语. Without headers, columns follow current role order, then instruction. Blank rows are skipped. Keep headers and place trials on the first sheet; save XLSX.

f930fe4cacf006c7696044b3297e8a99bf6b2158.source: 先导入对应组刺激并保存当前设计，再点击<s id="0">导入序列 XLSX</s>选择文件。界面没有工作表选择器，导入会替换试次列表。
f930fe4cacf006c7696044b3297e8a99bf6b2158.translation: Import stimuli into their groups and save the current design first. Then <s id="0">Import sequence XLSX</s>. There is no sheet selector; importing replaces the trial list.

328cdba995651033cbd75e2d4fb1729371066f31.source: 看到序列已载入后转到<s id="0">序列</s>核对。匹配限同角色组，优先按 SHA-256，缺少 hash 时按路径、名称或路径末尾文件名；只找到唯一候选才自动关联。
328cdba995651033cbd75e2d4fb1729371066f31.translation: After the loaded message, check <s id="0">Sequence</s>. Matching stays within roles, prioritizes SHA-256, and otherwise uses path, name, or trailing filename. Only unique candidates link automatically.

66857a09a1caed9930cf08191775c34be20f4f12.source: 缺失或歧义时明确选文件，也可修正工作簿再导入。检查行数、顺序、指导语及分段范围，保存最终设计并重新预检。
66857a09a1caed9930cf08191775c34be20f4f12.translation: Resolve missing/ambiguous files explicitly, or correct and reimport the workbook. Check rows, order, instructions, and segment ranges, save the final design, and rerun preflight.

bb9cff93dc6ecbbd0c2c045a8fe86b5cefe23ff4.source: 实际导入导出的示例 XLSX 后，界面提示序列已载入，并要求处理同名歧义和缺失素材。导入会替换当前试次表，随后应切到序列页逐行检查。
bb9cff93dc6ecbbd0c2c045a8fe86b5cefe23ff4.translation: After actual reimport of the exported example XLSX, a loaded notice requests resolving same-name ambiguities and missing materials. Trials are replaced; check each row on Sequence.

00408cac37e7e9f8ccb0616bd55894c4fa32e609.source: 实际导入导出的示例 XLSX 后，界面提示序列已载入，并要求处理同名歧义和缺失素材
00408cac37e7e9f8ccb0616bd55894c4fa32e609.translation: Actual XLSX reimport reports sequence loaded and requests resolving ambiguous names and missing materials.

9c7c20226d5cd8716a6ed068f4d1ed1443d7adfd.source: 保存设计和跨设备使用
9c7c20226d5cd8716a6ed068f4d1ed1443d7adfd.translation: Save designs and move across devices

4f3aa54659bdea40ea65e6f1bd0c3ff8b9dd7bee.source: 保存当前设备的设计，星号表示已编辑；不代替文件备份。
4f3aa54659bdea40ea65e6f1bd0c3ff8b9dd7bee.translation: Saves design on this device; an asterisk marks edits. It does not replace file backups.

ea75de7e5bae0508a2bf56757948ab7707bb953a.source: 生成 <s id="0">m15-project.json</s>，保留范式、素材信息、序列、参数、问卷与洗牌记录，<s id="1">不含刺激本体和被试结果</s>。
ea75de7e5bae0508a2bf56757948ab7707bb953a.translation: Creates <s id="0">m15-project.json</s> with paradigm, material metadata, sequence, parameters, questionnaire, and shuffle records, <s id="1">excluding actual stimuli and participant results</s>.

3a63e38f97003425949407c172755b2ea758c41e.source: 顶部加载设计 JSON；右栏从本机记录载入。会替换设计，先保留未保存修改。
3a63e38f97003425949407c172755b2ea758c41e.translation: Load design JSON at the top or local records on the right. This replaces design; retain unsaved changes first.

d0e80e3127b32c1f5e0955ccd6ff12551de1d3bb.source: 刷新本机记录、恢复 / 导出会话
d0e80e3127b32c1f5e0955ccd6ff12551de1d3bb.translation: Refresh local records / Restore or export session

451705b2091d6fb948b0e0c29bfa0e7145fae6ee.source: 刷新列表或进入已有被试的会话；恢复会话使用它的设计快照。
451705b2091d6fb948b0e0c29bfa0e7145fae6ee.translation: Refresh lists or open an existing participant session, using its design snapshot.

9355d0b09c448961b32a9cb4e47c0c4bf48ecf36.source: 最近会话结果、查看结果

ad53edc3081df5bc82923634061486e86c77845d.source: 保留最近退出的会话，查看不会创建新被试。
ad53edc3081df5bc82923634061486e86c77845d.translation: Retains the most recently exited session; viewing does not create a new participant.

ef4be0f87f3c824ecd28c8797dae2ba9ac31037d.source: 完成设计后点击<s id="0">保存本机项目</s>，再<s id="1">导出项目 JSON</s>，需要时导出序列 XLSX。<s id="2">项目 JSON、结果 JSON 与原刺激分别保留。</s>
ef4be0f87f3c824ecd28c8797dae2ba9ac31037d.translation: After design, <s id="0">Save local project</s> and <s id="1">Export project JSON</s>; export sequence XLSX if needed. <s id="2">Keep project JSON, result JSON, and original stimuli separately.</s>

879f88218a279194e55509c10faf89e858efb856.source: 换设备先加载项目 JSON，再把<s id="0">相同内容</s>文件导入对应角色组，相同 hash 可重新关联。逐行检查并重新预检，同名改过的文件不能替代原素材。
879f88218a279194e55509c10faf89e858efb856.translation: On another device, load project JSON and import files with <s id="0">identical contents</s> into their roles. Matching hashes can relink. Check every row and preflight again; changed same-name files cannot replace originals.

7ac5c582012c9ea71c41c1cc0101638d13dd0691.source: 旧项目只能恢复实际记录的配置、问卷与列表，未保存的复杂角色需重建。当前没有把结果 JSON 导回会话的入口，本机恢复依赖仍在的记录。
7ac5c582012c9ea71c41c1cc0101638d13dd0691.translation: Older projects restore only recorded configurations, questionnaires, and lists; unsaved complex roles need rebuilding. Result JSON cannot currently be imported back into a session. Local recovery needs surviving records.

2d6535c7a5b9ea1cc48d7a1e1849d507268b7fc9.source: 更换浏览器、站点地址或桌面配置目录，以及清理站点数据，可能看不到原记录。转移或清理前先导出需要的项目与结果文件。
2d6535c7a5b9ea1cc48d7a1e1849d507268b7fc9.translation: Changing browser, site address, or desktop profile, or clearing site data, may hide old records. Export needed projects and results before transfer or cleanup.

0bb516088e2361f104e4fde2a428a35d13253e40.source: 停止本模块预览与公共播放器，自行暂停其他录制、播放和重型任务，点击右栏<s id="0">预检与试音</s>。程序检查参数、问卷、试次数、素材关联、内容校验和解码。
0bb516088e2361f104e4fde2a428a35d13253e40.translation: Stop this module's preview and the shared player, and manually pause other recording, playback, and heavy tasks. Click <s id="0">Preflight and sound check</s> on the right. Parameters, questionnaire, trial count, links, hashes, and decoding are checked.

d7ad42444baa3ad797c4c6fb4fa02b1d4be534a0.source: 等待<s id="0">预检通过</s>。失败时按消息修正缺失关联、文件或预算等问题，再预检；<s id="1">填写被试信息</s>保持不可用。
d7ad42444baa3ad797c4c6fb4fa02b1d4be534a0.translation: Wait for <s id="0">Preflight passed</s>. Fix reported links, files, or budgets and retry if it fails; <s id="1">Enter participant details</s> stays disabled.

e70d7c77efbf9cbf641dfe8db94aa9af4cee2213.source: <s id="0">实际听见试音、确认设备和音量正确后</s>勾选<s id="1">已听见试音，设备正确</s>，确认环境后勾选<s id="2">已暂停其他录制、播放及重型任务</s>，再点击<s id="3">填写被试信息</s>。
e70d7c77efbf9cbf641dfe8db94aa9af4cee2213.translation: <s id="0">Actually hear the test and verify device and volume</s>, then check <s id="1">I heard the test; device is correct</s>. Verify the environment, check <s id="2">Other recording, playback, and heavy tasks are paused</s>, then <s id="3">Enter participant details</s>.

0e2afe0282130fd71fea33b2375b74947ec0b8ce.source: 试音不改变系统设备或音量，也不替你结束外部任务。设计修改、预览或再次预检会撤销旧试音确认，需重新检查。
0e2afe0282130fd71fea33b2375b74947ec0b8ce.translation: Sound check does not alter system devices/volume or stop external tasks. Design edits, previews, or another preflight revoke old confirmation; check again.

e31593bb059e8a975910f310b8eda04faca45f30.source: 配置、刺激关联和解码预检通过后，实验主持人需听见试音并确认设备与环境，再勾选两项确认。
e31593bb059e8a975910f310b8eda04faca45f30.translation: After configuration, links, and decoding pass, the experimenter must hear the test and check devices/environment before checking both boxes.

21387930e22cc9e7246e884f5f0c6a3109d994dc.source: 配置、刺激关联和解码预检通过后，两项确认仍需实验主持人检查
21387930e22cc9e7246e884f5f0c6a3109d994dc.translation: After configuration/link/decoding checks pass, both confirmations still require the experimenter's inspection.

baeca1f4df4a69a5508c6b91bd45d53a38e5860e.source: 刺激较多时可能采用试次间分块预加载，属于正常反馈。预检检查当前试次所引用的材料，不检查未使用材料；是否真实发声仍需人工确认。
baeca1f4df4a69a5508c6b91bd45d53a38e5860e.translation: Many stimuli may use between-trial chunked preloading; this is normal. Preflight checks referenced stimuli only, not unused ones. Actual sound output needs human confirmation.

96f869404c3c4e65318f0f0f7768556ac85c2f8a.translation: Complete the questionnaire and create a session

da57315610742113dac1450e08dc7d0b69942cdd.source: 在表单中输入文本、选择单选或勾选多选，带星号项必须填写。需要改设计时点击<s id="0">返回设计</s>，修改后重新预检。
da57315610742113dac1450e08dc7d0b69942cdd.translation: Enter text and select choices; starred items are required. To edit design, <s id="0">Return to design</s> and preflight again afterward.

652c7e7a5e67d9c3057e49fd6d943ae6ae049c28.source: 点击<s id="0">建立独立会话</s>，答案有误时按提示补齐。成功后保存问卷与当前设计，生成独立 ID，进入指导语页，刺激尚未播放。
652c7e7a5e67d9c3057e49fd6d943ae6ae049c28.translation: Click <s id="0">Create independent session</s>, correcting answers if prompted. Success saves answers/current design, generates independent IDs, and opens instructions without playing stimuli yet.

13d56ab615bfb66e9fe05be18fdfd6cded00fc25.source: 填写被试信息页根据问卷设置生成空表单，星号表示必填。图中字段用于操作演示，未填写任何真人被试信息。
13d56ab615bfb66e9fe05be18fdfd6cded00fc25.translation: Participant-details page generates an empty form from the questionnaire, with required asterisks. These fields are an operation example; no real participant data are entered.

8d5e8aee1c8044afc551b03d4de9351d3f65bd24.source: 填写被试信息页根据问卷设置生成空表单，星号表示必填
8d5e8aee1c8044afc551b03d4de9351d3f65bd24.translation: Empty participant form generated from the questionnaire, with required asterisks.

adc75cb0788dbbd540532f3afeea8ef8a1068bc9.source: 被试可全程使用键盘：问卷用 Tab 切换，单选用方向键，多选用空格，回车提交。指导语页按空格或回车开始，阶段提示、手动进入试次和手动播放也使用空格或回车，页面均显示对应提示。作答时用下方列出的反应键，Esc 可暂停。每次按键后松开，阶段推进键不会同时提交答案。
adc75cb0788dbbd540532f3afeea8ef8a1068bc9.translation: Participants can use the keyboard throughout: Tab between questions, arrows for single choice, Space for multiple choice, Enter to submit. Space/Enter starts instructions, advances phases/trials, and starts manual playback, with on-screen hints. Use listed response keys to answer and Esc to pause. Release after each press; an advance event cannot also answer.

60d49c615d040d30b87ccd8125e407c0dbffc686.source: 阅读指导语和阶段提示

e3731b8bd889d979d8f5c3344440419c2b943912.source: 阅读任务说明并确认反应键，准备好后点击<s id="0">开始实验</s>。点击空白处不会开始，指导语页不接收答案。
e3731b8bd889d979d8f5c3344440419c2b943912.translation: Read the task and response keys, then <s id="0">Start experiment</s>. Blank-area clicks do not start; the instruction page accepts no answers.

82fd3ce0dab2d76e41515331ba816710d1c241d7.source: 进入专注呈现后保持窗口在前台。需要纠正设计时先返回设计器，已建立会话的设置不会随设计自动变化。
82fd3ce0dab2d76e41515331ba816710d1c241d7.translation: Keep the focused presentation window in front. To correct design, return to the designer; an existing session does not follow later design edits automatically.

64eacf025d88a409c89d20f67acb8e09a142daab.source: 建立独立会话后先显示实验指导语，点击开始实验才进入流程。
64eacf025d88a409c89d20f67acb8e09a142daab.translation: An independent session first shows instructions; Start experiment begins the flow.

f7fcd0e2d40af146cd03ca2b5b7a1dd9d8bd0e5e.source: 建立独立会话后先显示实验指导语，点击开始实验才进入流程
f7fcd0e2d40af146cd03ca2b5b7a1dd9d8bd0e5e.translation: Independent session showing instructions before Start experiment.

d92a0c929e018ca7e2066ac60cf06b44850d02ea.source: 若到达分段起始位置且有阶段提示，先阅读提示，点击<s id="0">继续阶段</s>或在呈现区按独立非组合键。用于继续的同一事件不会同时提交答案。
d92a0c929e018ca7e2066ac60cf06b44850d02ea.translation: At a segment start with a prompt, read it, then <s id="0">Continue phase</s> or press an unmodified individual key in the presentation area. That same event cannot submit an answer.

7801a697f03cff2502f3132bd50ae168c75a470d.source: 到达按键分段的起始试次时先显示阶段提示和当前有效键。点击继续阶段后进入试次间页面。
7801a697f03cff2502f3132bd50ae168c75a470d.translation: At the starting trial of a key segment, the phase prompt and active keys appear first. Continue phase opens the between-trial page.

f269c7620866ce7b7607c5aa7e2df37888a78016.source: 到达按键分段的起始试次时先显示阶段提示和当前有效键
f269c7620866ce7b7607c5aa7e2df37888a78016.translation: Phase prompt and active keys at the start of a key segment.

4edf90bcc00ccc143067b88ddf69019d72b4f2b2.translation: Enter a trial and start playback

ea02c5714e07495b695ee97e36742b59f72923a5.source: 试次间页显示本行指导语；行内为空时才按全局开关使用全局文字。整条 ABX/AXB 序列共用一条指导语。
ea02c5714e07495b695ee97e36742b59f72923a5.translation: The between-trial page shows the row instruction. Only empty rows use global text when enabled. A whole ABX/AXB sequence shares one instruction.

84e829d846a64b3739727ec25fc6a0283feed0a6.source: 自动推进等待所设间隔；<s id="0">按键继续</s>需点击<s id="1">进入试次</s>或按空格、回车。需要读长提示时选手动或足够间隔，0 ms 自动推进可能一闪而过。
84e829d846a64b3739727ec25fc6a0283feed0a6.translation: Automatic progression waits the interval. <s id="0">Press to continue</s> needs <s id="1">Enter trial</s> or Space/Enter. For long text choose manual or sufficient delay; 0 ms automatic progression can flash past.

e620b6aa0013a68c75725f1f399fadf94af6f3f2.source: 试次间页面显示序列表中该行的指导语。推进方式为按键继续时，点击进入试次才进入下一步；手动等待不按自动试次间隔倒计时。
e620b6aa0013a68c75725f1f399fadf94af6f3f2.translation: Between-trial page showing its row instruction. Press to continue needs Enter trial; manual waiting does not count down the automatic interval.

5feda1ee683bcfd93589791b4b80cff4043292ee.source: 试次间页面显示序列表中该行的指导语
5feda1ee683bcfd93589791b4b80cff4043292ee.translation: Between-trial page showing the sequence row's instruction.

5b58e5e344a7189f71701aa936c3e2f0b46d48e1.source: 开启自动播放会进入刺激准备；关闭后停在<s id="0">等待手动播放</s>，再点击<s id="1">播放当前试次</s>或按空格、回车。启动键不计为答案。
5b58e5e344a7189f71701aa936c3e2f0b46d48e1.translation: Autoplay starts stimulus preparation. With it off, <s id="0">Waiting for manual playback</s> remains until <s id="1">Play current trial</s> or Space/Enter. The start key is not an answer.

50a754bbe4a70e63173c2a4cee6f1f6c6ef48fd8.source: 关闭自动播放后，进入试次仍停在等待手动播放。点击播放当前试次才开始准备和呈现刺激，J/F 尚未用于作答。
50a754bbe4a70e63173c2a4cee6f1f6c6ef48fd8.translation: With autoplay off, entering the trial still waits for manual playback. Play current trial starts preparation/presentation; J/F do not answer yet.

1d3a39932daf57d6d6569f122563a88cd19782d0.source: 关闭自动播放后，进入试次仍停在等待手动播放
1d3a39932daf57d6d6569f122563a88cd19782d0.translation: Autoplay off: the entered trial waits for manual playback.

6cbfc7ee35b973a473f237fbb64af7624535c215.source: 准备成功后开始呈现。音频按范式顺序高亮角色卡片，角色间静默时没有活动高亮；开启文件名只显示 X 名称，当前播放角色由卡片高亮标示。
6cbfc7ee35b973a473f237fbb64af7624535c215.translation: Presentation starts after preparation. Audio role cards highlight in paradigm order, with no active card during silence. Filename display shows X only; highlighting identifies the playing role.

fc637dc8571b592859b9fe8c1afa4d9b27cf527e.source: 看到<s id="0">正在播放，请等待</s>时听完全部角色。<s id="1">播放和准备期间按键不会提交答案。</s>正式音频页显示角色卡片，没有动态波形。
fc637dc8571b592859b9fe8c1afa4d9b27cf527e.translation: At <s id="0">Playing, please wait</s>, listen through all roles. <s id="1">Keys during preparation/playback do not answer.</s> The formal audio page has role cards without a dynamic waveform.

9014ed5d129b505bf940c722a95d8c05b5304852.source: ABX 演示试次正在播放 A，角色卡片随实际播放顺序高亮。播放期间显示请等待，全部角色播放结束才开放作答。图中使用合成刺激。
9014ed5d129b505bf940c722a95d8c05b5304852.translation: ABX demo playing A; role cards highlight in actual order. Please wait remains during playback, and responses open only after all roles end. Stimuli are synthesized.

22fa593179e96998389c8f5db255c0eb1cfc3ba4.source: ABX 演示试次正在播放 A，角色卡片随实际播放顺序高亮
22fa593179e96998389c8f5db255c0eb1cfc3ba4.translation: ABX demo playing A with role cards highlighted in actual playback order.

18e37226becd01491b594ab008691b356b7fa067.source: 出现<s id="0">请作答</s>后按一个页面所列的有效键并松开。焦点仍在按钮上时先点击呈现区空白处。每次呈现只接受一次回答，保存成功后进入下一试次。
18e37226becd01491b594ab008691b356b7fa067.translation: After <s id="0">Please respond</s>, press one listed valid key and release. If a button still has focus, click a blank part of presentation first. Each presentation accepts one answer; successful saving advances.

0b7b152e9d337c2588a3b16ab008fab03c20da2e.source: 所有角色播放结束后显示请作答，此时 J/F 才能记录答案与反应时。软件反应时的定义见本章计时说明。
0b7b152e9d337c2588a3b16ab008fab03c20da2e.translation: Please respond appears after all roles finish; only then can J/F record answers and RT. See the timing section for software RT definition.

863ff5b2580ee81f69363e3e44d12d364bd0ef62.source: 所有角色播放结束后显示请作答，此时 J/F 才能记录答案与反应时
863ff5b2580ee81f69363e3e44d12d364bd0ef62.translation: All roles finished; Please respond enables J/F answer and RT recording.

6ae3e338ef1e471fb2d35e5b7ff4c7cda68b981a.source: X 图片/TXT 准备并显示后才开放作答，没有可调的视觉显示时长。实验没有答案超时、自动跳过或独立无记录重听按钮，等待期间可由主持人暂停或结束。
6ae3e338ef1e471fb2d35e5b7ff4c7cda68b981a.translation: X images/TXT accept responses only after preparation/display, without adjustable visual duration. There is no answer timeout, auto-skip, or separate unrecorded replay. The experimenter can pause or end while waiting.

53c5bff22ee2f4d95d46ef75ba50ca044e7f2615.source: 活动页点击<s id="0">暂停</s>，停止呈现并保留已完成答案。受影响的试次记为中断尝试（attempt），与正常反应分开。
53c5bff22ee2f4d95d46ef75ba50ca044e7f2615.translation: Click <s id="0">Pause</s> on the active page to stop presentation and retain completed answers. The affected trial becomes an interrupted attempt, separate from normal responses.

f57b9a45dc52faf45fbb5346508bb65e2e899293.source: 核查原因和设备。需要复核或试音确认失效时点击<s id="0">复核刺激并试音</s>，通过后勾选<s id="1">已确认恢复试音</s>。
f57b9a45dc52faf45fbb5346508bb65e2e899293.translation: Check cause and devices. If review is needed or sound confirmation expired, <s id="0">Review stimuli and sound check</s>, then check <s id="1">Recovery sound check confirmed</s>.

feb68913f124c789bd6c416b3515c79385620379.source: 点击<s id="0">明确继续 / 重新呈现</s>，已有尝试时确认新建 attempt。旧中断记录保留，当前试次从头重呈现，反应时重新起算。
feb68913f124c789bd6c416b3515c79385620379.translation: Click <s id="0">Explicitly continue / Present again</s>; confirm a new attempt if one exists. Old interruptions remain. The current trial restarts from the beginning with a new RT origin.

9dfa74d8dc885a94f9e3a23932b4a4ff5eb9096d.source: 在第二试次播放中点击暂停后，页面保留中断 attempt，提供明确继续和重新呈现。此前中断不计作正常反应，继续会创建新的 attempt。
9dfa74d8dc885a94f9e3a23932b4a4ff5eb9096d.translation: Pausing during trial two retains an interrupted attempt and offers explicit continuation/re-presentation. The interruption is not a normal response; continuing creates a new attempt.

5d03d8fd17e666536e74839454b2e5e1035b8037.source: 在第二试次播放中点击暂停后，页面保留中断 attempt，提供明确继续和重新呈现
5d03d8fd17e666536e74839454b2e5e1035b8037.translation: Trial-two pause retains an interrupted attempt with explicit continuation/re-presentation.

fdcb8136bc41b43b9f7afe14ec665fd8f5b32ce2.source: 失焦、隐藏/切换模块或标签、设备和音频状态变化、明显调度停顿等会尝试暂停。主持人需检查实际接线与声音。专注页覆盖工作台，窗口全屏可按系统操作设置。
fdcb8136bc41b43b9f7afe14ec665fd8f5b32ce2.translation: Focus loss, hiding/switching module or tab, device/audio changes, or major scheduling stalls attempt to pause. The experimenter must check actual connections and sound. Focus mode covers the workbench; use system controls for window fullscreen.

cfd8d4df949fa2e6dd975e758e9bef50834abc54.source: 结果格式 + 导出结果

553862c2206fa937167733464937fc080dcb1252.source: 一个按钮配合格式选择，支持完整 JSON 和分析 XLSX/CSV；活动实验导出会先暂停并留下中断记录。
553862c2206fa937167733464937fc080dcb1252.translation: One button with a format selector supports full JSON and analysis XLSX/CSV. Exporting during a run pauses it and records an interruption.

8fca9efc19bd670cd108e056216af12260853374.source: 自然完成或首次提前结束时自动请求 <s id="0">m15-会话ID.xlsx</s>，恢复终态结果不重复下载。
8fca9efc19bd670cd108e056216af12260853374.translation: Natural completion or first early ending requests <s id="0">m15-sessionID.xlsx</s> automatically. Restoring terminal results does not repeat downloading.

79f0b1c46fb4f41ff4ef7a320e408ffea3c35ba1.source: <s id="0">先保存，成功后返回初始素材页</s>，保留设计、素材和最近结果；保存失败仍留在运行页。
79f0b1c46fb4f41ff4ef7a320e408ffea3c35ba1.translation: <s id="0">Saves first and returns to initial Materials only on success</s>, retaining design, stimuli, and latest results. Save failure stays on the run page.

9f79a3afd7cc3505c96f39772a393f108b9af329.source: 在非专注状态可退出运行视图并保留会话。暂停会话可从本机记录再恢复，保存失败时不能正常退出。
9f79a3afd7cc3505c96f39772a393f108b9af329.translation: Outside focus mode, exits run view while retaining the session. Paused sessions can be restored from local records; save failure blocks normal exit.

9a391e81745fa6347f97755b1ab1db3b9bc06ade.source: 只可确认当前结果已发出的导出请求；新反应、中断或活动恢复会撤销旧确认。
9a391e81745fa6347f97755b1ab1db3b9bc06ade.translation: Confirms only an issued export request for current results. New answers, interruptions, or active restoration revoke it.

3068e8e565a6f6cde3af5777f8ee9786d7930bf0.source: 自然完成后等待本地保存，核对完成反应与中断/异常数量。会话为 <s id="0">completed</s>，自动请求 XLSX。
3068e8e565a6f6cde3af5777f8ee9786d7930bf0.translation: On natural completion, wait for local saving and check completed responses and interruptions/anomalies. Session status is <s id="0">completed</s>, with automatic XLSX request.

e2bdda1333bd08785727857e4af147452c85a713.source: 需要提前停止时点击<s id="0">结束实验</s>，保留已完成和部分结果，未完成尝试记为中断，会话为 <s id="1">ended</s>，并请求 XLSX。
e2bdda1333bd08785727857e4af147452c85a713.translation: For early stopping, <s id="0">End experiment</s>. Completed/partial results remain; unfinished attempts become interrupted, status <s id="1">ended</s>, and XLSX is requested.

ba09b227f2d9440e1e188f8982e87e8586b70bb7.source: 自然完成后也可点击<s id="0">结束实验</s>，成功保存才返回素材页。<s id="1">保存位置选好后还要检查实际文件，取消后请重新导出。</s>
ba09b227f2d9440e1e188f8982e87e8586b70bb7.translation: After natural completion, <s id="0">End experiment</s> also returns to Materials only after successful saving. <s id="1">After choosing a location, inspect the actual file. Re-export if canceled.</s>

b5f7f378438efdc89a34bd955c36432e1cc50cfd.source: 两个演示试次自然完成，结束页显示两个完成反应和一个中断 attempt，并自动请求 XLSX。
b5f7f378438efdc89a34bd955c36432e1cc50cfd.translation: Two demo trials complete naturally. The ending page shows two completed responses and one interrupted attempt and automatically requests XLSX.

9a4dedc791dc6807f8b8a6e941aa0a078bb14f84.source: 返回后，素材和设计继续保留，<s id="0">最近会话结果</s>可导出或查看；试音和环境确认清空。
9a4dedc791dc6807f8b8a6e941aa0a078bb14f84.translation: After return, materials/design remain and <s id="0">Latest session results</s> can be viewed/exported. Sound and environment confirmations reset.

e177cc8bce0bf75a0147502dd6d01876b8f71e0e.source: 保存并结束实验后返回素材页，顶部保留最近会话及统一结果导出入口。素材和设计继续保留，下一位被试需重新预检并填写空表单。
e177cc8bce0bf75a0147502dd6d01876b8f71e0e.translation: After saving and ending, Materials returns with the latest session and unified export controls at the top. Materials/design remain; the next participant needs new preflight and an empty form.

9c0e8e585ba642c1b65b73410020ae763acad533.source: 保存并结束实验后返回素材页，顶部保留最近会话及统一结果导出入口
9c0e8e585ba642c1b65b73410020ae763acad533.translation: After saving and ending, Materials retains the latest session and unified result export above.

d7e0026bf1410fa4f70c6744dbaa43bd8597e62d.source: 在结果入口选择 <s id="0">JSON（完整溯源）</s>并点击<s id="1">导出结果</s>，保留完整设计、问卷、顺序和全部尝试。需要分析时同样选择 <s id="2">XLSX（分析表格）</s>或 <s id="3">CSV（分析表格）</s>导出。项目 JSON 不能代替结果 JSON。
d7e0026bf1410fa4f70c6744dbaa43bd8597e62d.translation: Choose <s id="0">JSON (full provenance)</s> and <s id="1">Export results</s> to retain full design, questionnaire, order, and all attempts. For analysis, select <s id="2">XLSX (analysis table)</s> or <s id="3">CSV (analysis table)</s>. Project JSON cannot replace result JSON.

558f5fd3c4155d812b9804fa24ed84806d553311.source: 打开或回读保存的文件，核对会话 ID、问卷、试次、状态和材料 hash。文件名为 <s id="0">m15-会话ID.扩展名</s>，与原刺激一起保留。
558f5fd3c4155d812b9804fa24ed84806d553311.translation: Open/read back saved files and check session ID, questionnaire, trials, status, and hashes. Names follow <s id="0">m15-会话ID.扩展名</s>; retain them with original stimuli.

e8952a6225b404045fc1edafdc656b1c08810f2f.source: 确认实际保存后点击<s id="0">确认导出文件已保存</s>。结果有更新时重新导出、检查并确认。
e8952a6225b404045fc1edafdc656b1c08810f2f.translation: After verifying actual saving, <s id="0">Confirm exported file saved</s>. When results change, export, check, and confirm again.

33c018959d705fb7f769aad66bb9f880ae5ca8da.source: 检查上一会话文件，需查看时点<s id="0">查看结果</s>。沿用同一设计无需重导素材；需不同顺序时先明确修改、保存。
33c018959d705fb7f769aad66bb9f880ae5ca8da.translation: Check the previous files; <s id="0">View results</s> if needed. The same design needs no reimport. For a different order, explicitly edit/save first.

32b2ba2c96b31752ff2173e7295f0d6c6d91ba64.source: 重新<s id="0">预检与试音</s>，人工确认设备和环境，再进入被试表单。<s id="1">下一份表单为空</s>，填写后建立新会话，不沿用上一位答案。
32b2ba2c96b31752ff2173e7295f0d6c6d91ba64.translation: Repeat <s id="0">Preflight and sound check</s>, confirm device/environment, then open participant details. <s id="1">The next form is empty</s>; create a new session without reusing previous answers.

d29a2673581182b4ffee57cdd19ecb90d1c87aae.source: 正常关闭可能提示未保存设计、未确认导出或保存失败。强制退出、崩溃和站点数据清理仍可能丢失尚未保存记录，关闭前检查文件备份。
d29a2673581182b4ffee57cdd19ecb90d1c87aae.translation: Normal closing may warn about unsaved design, unconfirmed export, or save failures. Forced exit, crashes, or site-data cleanup may lose unsaved records. Check file backups before closing.

1887cbde4ff67b80dd77f261adf1431ca6934a65.source: <s id="0">JSON</s>保留项目快照、问卷、最终顺序、随机化记录、全部尝试及计时诊断，不含刺激文件。<s id="1">XLSX 的 Results 与 CSV 一行一个 attempt</s>，中断也占行，行数可能大于设计试次数。
1887cbde4ff67b80dd77f261adf1431ca6934a65.translation: <s id="0">JSON</s> retains the project snapshot, questionnaire, final order, randomization, all attempts, and timing diagnostics, without stimulus files. <s id="1">XLSX Results and CSV have one row per attempt</s>, including interruptions, so rows can exceed planned trials.

9dbf6179902984bf3ad46a4d654546146fee50b4.source: 外部被试编号、独立被试/会话 ID 和问卷答案。合并数据时保留归属。
9dbf6179902984bf3ad46a4d654546146fee50b4.translation: External participant number, independent participant/session IDs, and answers. Retain ownership when combining data.

8ca04f5a70f4e75194bd0a49b1ac69f210addfab.source: 尝试结束时间，缺失时取开始时间，使用 UTC。完整 ISO 时间在 JSON 中。
8ca04f5a70f4e75194bd0a49b1ac69f210addfab.translation: Attempt end time, falling back to start time if absent, in UTC. Full ISO timestamps are in JSON.

ec497a50fc145e546b629492122b8de185355e48.source: 实际顺序中从 1 开始的试次位置、尝试 ID、该试次第几次呈现。
ec497a50fc145e546b629492122b8de185355e48.translation: Actual 1-based trial position, attempt ID, and presentation number for that trial.

142285585ebc2feaa325abbd3d1ed583da2a362a.source: X 名称、参照名称和内容 hash。X 是图片/TXT 时仍用 Audio_Filename 这一列名。
142285585ebc2feaa325abbd3d1ed583da2a362a.translation: X/reference names and hashes. X images/TXT still use the column name Audio_Filename.

da66324e878d490680821f935c6d777ea008c82d.source: 有效键与软件反应时（ms），中断尝试不延续旧 RT。
da66324e878d490680821f935c6d777ea008c82d.translation: Valid key and software RT (ms). Interrupted attempts do not continue old RT.

6884fc1d762676128a7cf2e0ca546053c5bda662.source: TRUE 对应 <s id="0">completed</s>，<s id="1">表示答案已记录</s>；Status/Reason 区分完成、中断和异常。
6884fc1d762676128a7cf2e0ca546053c5bda662.translation: TRUE corresponds to <s id="0">completed</s> and <s id="1">means an answer was recorded</s>. Status/Reason distinguish completed, interrupted, and abnormal attempts.

6057d9f46448a65769ffc4efc5cbb573a9a2440b.source: 范式与 RT 定义；开放/事件/处理时间和 Time_Origin 用于检查计时，缺失值不要补成 0。
6057d9f46448a65769ffc4efc5cbb573a9a2440b.translation: Paradigm/RT definition; opening, event, handling times, and Time_Origin support timing checks. Do not fill missing values with 0.

ad3dac94ee3a96cc3b2cb42129c14577870deb60.source: 分析前检查 <s id="0">completed</s> 与同试次的中断/异常尝试。分析页可汇总每位被试的反应时与准确率。仅有标准答案的完成作答参与准确率，程序不自动剔除离群值，需按预定分析规则检查。CSV 使用 UTF-8 BOM；可能触发公式的文字加前置单引号保护，JSON 保留原内容。
ad3dac94ee3a96cc3b2cb42129c14577870deb60.translation: Before analysis, check <s id="0">completed</s> and interrupted/abnormal attempts for the same trial. Analysis summarizes RT and accuracy by participant. Accuracy uses only completed responses with correct answers. No automatic outlier removal is performed; follow prespecified rules. CSV uses UTF-8 BOM and prefixes formula-like text with an apostrophe; JSON retains originals.

904c51d85366cbff3a5ad4b5d74b4fd50d5ec791.source: 本章两个设计试次中，第二试次暂停后重呈现，因此导出三行。J/F 由自动化演示发送。
904c51d85366cbff3a5ad4b5d74b4fd50d5ec791.translation: Two planned trials produce three rows because trial two was paused and presented again. J/F were sent by demonstration automation.

5149a8cda04ba72f30a42ff2af4d8ec4ee6131b7.source: 第二行原因是 <s id="0">manual-pause</s>，RT 留空；第三行保留新的尝试。旧中断没有被覆盖，TRUE 只说明记录为完成反应。
5149a8cda04ba72f30a42ff2af4d8ec4ee6131b7.translation: Row two has reason <s id="0">manual-pause</s> and empty RT; row three retains a new attempt. The old interruption is not overwritten. TRUE only marks a completed response.

7f0471fd0bb0ffe1b36c1db43dc7e7a951213aab.source: 结束实验返回设计页后选择分析。页面读取当前项目在当前设备、浏览器及账号项目中保存的会话，每个会话独立一行，保留姓名或编号、被试 UUID、会话身份和状态。同名记录不会自动合并，提前结束的会话也可查看。点击刷新分析更新本机记录。
7f0471fd0bb0ffe1b36c1db43dc7e7a951213aab.translation: After ending and returning to design, choose Analysis. It reads saved sessions for the current project in this device/browser/account project. Each row retains name/number, participant UUID, session identity/status. Same names are not merged; ended sessions are included. Refresh analysis updates local records.

29170eabd2aacb28cb73f41b280243861fa6d172.source: 表格显示完成与未完成试次、RT 样本数、平均反应时、中位数、第一四分位数 Q1、第三四分位数 Q3、四分位距、样本标准差、最小及最大反应时，以及中断、无效尝试和缺失 RT 数。每试次取最后一次完成作答，RT 只纳入有限且非负的值，保留 0 ms。四分位数采用 R type 7 线性插值，四分位距为 Q3−Q1，样本标准差使用 n−1；单个样本的标准差为空。四分位数方法见 <x id="0"/>
29170eabd2aacb28cb73f41b280243861fa6d172.translation: The table shows completed/incomplete trials, RT sample count, mean, median, Q1, Q3, IQR, sample SD, minimum/maximum RT, and interrupted/invalid/missing-RT counts. Each trial uses its last completed answer. RT includes finite nonnegative values, retaining 0 ms. Quartiles use R type 7 linear interpolation; IQR is Q3−Q1 and sample SD uses n−1. A single sample has empty SD. Quartile method: <x id="0"/>

1274a2f7870e7dff3b6f739144354f9c10a626ce.source: 准确率等于正确数除以有标准答案且完成作答的试次数，同时列出正确数、计分数、未设答案或无法计分数与未完成数。无可计分试次显示未计分。默认使用各会话保存的标准答案。已有实验可在序列中补设答案，再选择当前设计的标准答案重新评分；只有相同试次及角色刺激摘要一致、答案属于原会话反应键的记录才计分，原始会话保持。
1274a2f7870e7dff3b6f739144354f9c10a626ce.translation: Accuracy is correct responses divided by completed trials with correct answers. Counts show correct, scored, unkeyed/unscorable, and incomplete trials; no scorable trials show Unscored. Default uses session-saved answers. Add answers in Sequence and rescore with current-design answers if needed. Only matching trial/role-stimulus digests with answers in original session keys are scored; original sessions remain unchanged.

a9ae776e78f8f04406e6917a2956cc87cd00ce58.source: 选择分析格式并点击导出被试分析。XLSX 的 Participants 工作表保存汇总，Scoring 工作表逐次列出反应键、标准答案、正确性、答案来源与是否纳入汇总。CSV 保存被试汇总。平均值和分位数单位为 ms，导出准确率为 0 到 1 的比例，页面显示百分比。结果表末尾也增加 Correct_Key 和 Is_Correct，空值表示未计分。保存标准答案设计 JSON，便于复核当前设计重新评分的依据。
a9ae776e78f8f04406e6917a2956cc87cd00ce58.translation: Choose analysis format and Export participant analysis. XLSX Participants stores summaries; Scoring lists keys, correct answers, correctness, answer source, and inclusion per trial. CSV stores participant summaries. Means/quantiles are ms; exported accuracy is 0–1 while the page shows percent. Results also add Correct_Key and Is_Correct; empty means unscored. Save the correct-answer design JSON to document rescoring.

4d90ccfeb4aae1ec270d4f98ef798e52699aaf2a.source: 重新进入感知实验，右栏点击<s id="0">刷新本机记录</s>，按时间、会话 ID 和进度找到目标，再点<s id="1">恢复 / 导出会话</s>。
4d90ccfeb4aae1ec270d4f98ef798e52699aaf2a.translation: Reopen Perception experiments and <s id="0">Refresh local records</s> on the right. Find by time, session ID, and progress, then <s id="1">Restore / Export session</s>.

bc7253e1e630ff2f833aac5f9d4ab81604547173.source: <s id="0">completed/ended</s> 会话只显示既有结果，不重放、不重算 RT，也不重复自动下载。活动会话停在安全暂停处，只能恢复已保存的边界。
bc7253e1e630ff2f833aac5f9d4ab81604547173.translation: <s id="0">completed/ended</s> sessions show existing results only, without replay, RT recalculation, or automatic redownload. Active sessions restore at a safe pause and only from saved boundaries.

cd18504f9da5167a74ff157b704d1a13f453d974.source: 已有结果可直接导出，即使刺激缺失。要继续，先<s id="0">复核刺激并试音</s>并确认，再点<s id="1">明确继续 / 重新呈现</s>。已完成试次不重做，中断的当前试次生成新尝试。
cd18504f9da5167a74ff157b704d1a13f453d974.translation: Existing results can export even without stimuli. To continue, <s id="0">Review stimuli and sound check</s>, confirm, then <s id="1">Explicitly continue / Present again</s>. Completed trials are not repeated; the interrupted current trial gets a new attempt.

eb64a73b0301500c94a134a45856220765abb123.source: 缺原刺激时先导出结果，返回设计器，把相同内容文件重新导入对应组，再恢复复核。<s id="0">重新导入时核对文件内容与原会话材料一致。</s>
eb64a73b0301500c94a134a45856220765abb123.translation: Without original stimuli, export results, return to design, import identical files into roles, then restore/review. <s id="0">Verify reimported contents match the original session.</s>

0363381b53ec677aae289f761a604b83ddbd89cc.source: 点击查看结果恢复已完成的演示会话，直接显示原有两个完成反应与一个中断 attempt。终态恢复不重放刺激、不重算 RT，也不再次自动下载。
0363381b53ec677aae289f761a604b83ddbd89cc.translation: View results restores the completed demo with two completed responses and one interruption, without replay, RT recalculation, or automatic downloading again.

a4132478834395e397d8524047dc30471ad576bf.source: 缺失 / 未关联、hash 不一致

44e93aa7f745fb09456633297c211f8b8a9ad5c3.source: 到序列选择正确材料，核对同名文件内容，必要时重导原内容文件。
44e93aa7f745fb09456633297c211f8b8a9ad5c3.translation: Choose correct materials in Sequence, check same-name content, and reimport original contents if needed.

db5fdac20ef60129411eec1debc8ede9312bf5bc.source: 解码失败、图片尺寸或预算错误
db5fdac20ef60129411eec1debc8ede9312bf5bc.translation: Decode failure, image dimensions, or budget error

f1554de837db4458fc588b118e1ee793c15c95ee.source: 检查格式、尺寸和限制，准备兼容副本时记录转换过程，重新导入预检。
f1554de837db4458fc588b118e1ee793c15c95ee.translation: Check formats, dimensions, and limits. Document conversions for compatible copies, reimport, and preflight.

be9aba4c7e030108e35b747f710ce70b5531cd0f.source: 补合法键和选项，修正位置范围。删除或复制试次后尤其要复核。
be9aba4c7e030108e35b747f710ce70b5531cd0f.translation: Fill valid keys/options and correct ranges, especially after deleting/duplicating trials.

ef648d1f0ce9f4c47a8d8b55df1857e6bf427d93.source: 播放、录音或未结束任务冲突

e341e644401592d9f533d7aabc4a313eda4dfe75.source: 自行停止冲突活动，再预检；程序不替你结束外部进程。
e341e644401592d9f533d7aabc4a313eda4dfe75.translation: Stop conflicts yourself, then preflight. The program does not terminate external processes.

a35460948fe2c5bcf2ea45505caa995a5c284f3d.source: 在原标签暂停并退出运行视图后再恢复，仅暂停会保留占用。
a35460948fe2c5bcf2ea45505caa995a5c284f3d.translation: Pause and exit run view in the original tab before restoring. Pausing alone retains ownership.

539cf9816e9dc2c9e5fe742bddaa127c4b3497e2.source: 本地保存失败 / 会话已被其他标签修改
539cf9816e9dc2c9e5fe742bddaa127c4b3497e2.translation: Local save failed / Session changed by another tab

1f7970fedee4ede8af9f1a137f4fba14f7f712e3.source: 保留页面，先导出内存记录，再排查存储或并发问题。不要并行运行同一会话。
1f7970fedee4ede8af9f1a137f4fba14f7f712e3.translation: Keep the page, export memory records first, then diagnose storage/concurrency. Do not run the same session concurrently.

f25d82c947d8fa3ac10c43a962c17ec473002c3f.source: 突然暂停、声音或按键异常
f25d82c947d8fa3ac10c43a962c17ec473002c3f.translation: Sudden pause, sound, or key problems

d9868bc409f3324fd11dc00c81424a19b61af660.source: 核查窗口焦点、设备和播放状态，复核试音后明确重新呈现。
d9868bc409f3324fd11dc00c81424a19b61af660.translation: Check focus, devices, and playback, repeat sound check, then explicitly present again.

c1d143aaf92bb10d90e3883ef45d34acbd5df863.source: <s id="0">保留当前窗口，先不要关闭或建立新会话。</s>保存失败时结果留在内存，正常结束与返回会受阻。
c1d143aaf92bb10d90e3883ef45d34acbd5df863.translation: <s id="0">Keep this window; do not close or create a new session yet.</s> Results remain in memory after failure, blocking normal ending/return.

dc69d20d34aa40cd140150ea8ef89a5ec2db5631.source: 选择 JSON 并点<s id="0">导出结果</s>保留内存记录，实际打开检查。文件请求可能已发出，但导出登记的本地写入仍失败。
dc69d20d34aa40cd140150ea8ef89a5ec2db5631.translation: Select JSON and <s id="0">Export results</s> to retain memory records, then open and check. A file request may succeed while local export-registration writing still fails.

ea45143264870cf29125fa5c58f70f0ec5e07abc.source: 检查存储和占用后点<s id="0">重试本地保存</s>。成功后活动会话回到暂停，终态回到结束状态，再按相应流程继续或退出。
ea45143264870cf29125fa5c58f70f0ec5e07abc.translation: After checking storage/ownership, <s id="0">Retry local save</s>. Success returns active sessions to pause or terminal sessions to their ending state, then continue/exit normally.

67288166bcb982cf56770cc73a492984e4be5565.source: 重新导出当前结果并确认保存，保留失败期间的 JSON 供核对。崩溃恢复取决于已提交边界，未保存也未导出的答案不能保证找回。
67288166bcb982cf56770cc73a492984e4be5565.translation: Re-export current results and confirm saving; retain the failure-period JSON for checks. Crash recovery depends on committed boundaries; unexported, unsaved answers cannot be guaranteed recoverable.

604f45140f4600609d40f67e739abfbd95bd946d.source: 软件 RT 从<s id="0">作答窗口开放到有效按键处理</s>计算。音频须等整段序列结束，ABX/AXB 不从 X 开始时计时；图片/TXT 在准备和两次呈现帧回调后开放。提前按键不记答案。
604f45140f4600609d40f67e739abfbd95bd946d.translation: Software RT runs from <s id="0">response-window opening to valid-key handling</s>. Audio waits for the whole sequence; ABX/AXB does not start RT at X onset. Images/TXT open after preparation and two presentation-frame callbacks. Early keys are not answers.

5b09a0917d16dc692c8da231ee712c5a44c769be.source: <s id="0">反应时记录采用软件时钟，设备时延需独立硬件测量。</s>结果保留软件时钟诊断，严格计时研究还需独立硬件测量，恢复也不接续旧 RT。
5b09a0917d16dc692c8da231ee712c5a44c769be.translation: <s id="0">RT uses a software clock; device latency requires separate hardware measurement.</s> Results retain clock diagnostics. Strict timing studies need hardware measurements; recovery does not continue old RT.

e551b0e3d9748edcbe7499cbc3d2cc8004e4b0a0.translation: Materials and design still need checking

d1b742aac4902eaaa55ba419241208045fe7cac5.source: 浏览器解码可能重采样，结果记录可读取的原 WAV 采样率和实际解码率，压缩格式原率可能为空。条件平衡、练习反馈与实验效度需按研究设计安排。暂停或重呈现规则请事先约定，并保留尝试状态。
d1b742aac4902eaaa55ba419241208045fe7cac5.translation: Browser decoding may resample. Results record readable original-WAV and decoded sample rates; compressed-original rates may be absent. Plan condition balance, practice feedback, and validity in the research design. Prespecify pause/re-presentation rules and retain attempt status.

b9fa138c4d58dace64ab3f69ad5e3b862e8a4201.source: 网页和刺激准备好后可在已打开页面断网运行和导出，浏览器关闭后断网冷启动尚未提供。桌面页使用内置资源，浏览器和桌面配置各自保存记录。正式实验前检查刺激、设备时延和运行环境。
b9fa138c4d58dace64ab3f69ad5e3b862e8a4201.translation: After page/stimuli preparation, the open web page can run/export offline. Offline cold startup after browser closing is not provided. Desktop uses bundled resources; browser/desktop profiles store records separately. Check stimuli, device latency, and environment before formal experiments.
